name: Final B Cut
source:
I made a once-in-a-lifetime mistake and decided to be punished
Indifferent soul guide (reaper) softens.

The studio editing shop called The A cut, which was entered based on the will of God,
Attractive men were waiting for her ...?

With a grim reaper who struggles to save someone
A healing story drawn by him who has come to be thrown at the crossroads of fate.

[From [url=https://welcon.kocca.kr/en/directory/content/final-b-cut--3918]website[/url]]
translation:
我犯下了一生难忘的错误，决定接受惩罚。
冷漠的引魂者，也渐渐动摇。

遵循神明的意志，踏入名为“The A cut”的影像剪辑工作室，
等待着她的，竟是魅力十足的男人们……？

努力拯救他人的死神，
与被推向命运岔路的人，一同描绘出一段治愈的故事。

[摘自[url=https://welcon.kocca.kr/en/directory/content/final-b-cut--3918]网站[/url]]
